scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
